我花了两天时间，把一些角色的行走图形象独特化了。我为本作设计的风格独特的行走图也是这个游戏的诸多特色之一。
这个风格的行走图应该应用在系列的其他作品上，比如想做的三国、日本战国的故事。  
言归正传，通过单位列表能直观的看到，比如这八名参战角色，同时有六种不同的形象。这不包括他们分别转变兵种为步、骑、炮、马车等兵种的情况。  每个有独特行走图的角色转变为其他兵种当然也是独特的，所以行走图的工作量和丰富性大约要乘四倍（四个基本兵种）。
有机会我会做一期视频盘点一下目前出现过的所有单位，欣赏一下他们的行走图。

新增并优化了猎刀等武器的图标。

装备中的武器、道具有高亮的提示，分别为蓝色和绿色，可以更清楚直观看到。花了整整一夜时间去重新设计这个功能，这就是为什么我的肝总是很疼的原因。

还有大量细节更新、优化。

The map that I used for the start screen and the description of the world situation, I wanted it to be like the Lord of the Rings, with mountains, rivers, cities and villages dotted around. notes.title: v1.3 Major update!
notes.notes:
This update will continue the content of v1.2, a comprehensive variety of ammunition, all characters initially carried, available, shop ammunition all reworked, which will further increase the supply and combat strategy!

New features for other weapons are also being redesigned to take into account the new counter-attack features added to the revolver.
The counterattack characteristics of the revolver are indeed very powerful, and you should think twice before you encounter any enemy armed with a revolver, so in addition to the range to avoid counterattack, there are other weapons that can suppress the revolver?
This time, the original design of the double-barreled shotgun increased the suppression effect of the revolver, which could avoid the counterattack of the revolver. Due to the characteristics of long-range rifles, revolvers and double-barreled shotguns, they form a restraint relationship between them, and this restraint relationship is included in other more abundant weapon types, greatly enriching the supply and combat strategy.
We can now declare a new level of balance of weapons, no longer a single long range rifle, but each weapon has its own advantages. Since each weapon has a corresponding type of ammunition, and ammunition supplies are limited, this prevents players from only stockpiling a certain type of gun (or only stockpiling a long range rifle).
However, even without supply constraints, just buying a long-range rifle is no longer the best option. In order to deal with the enemy who may be equipped with a variety of weapons, we must also enrich the types of weapons in the warehouse!

Next update preview: Big Map Travel and new elements in travel

This time, there will be a complete overhaul of the big map system, which will involve a lot of different areas of work, the most obvious being hand-drawn new big maps. Before simplified the big map part, after all, the big map is more or less independent of the main plot and combat system, the priority is not so high, so it is not detailed, this time finished the other parts, finally can do a good job of this part.

Torian

notes.title: v1.2 Sharps Rifle vs. Colt Revolver
notes.notes:
As the Sharps rifles arrived in Kansas and were assigned to their respective roles, a new problem arose.     In history, one of our main characters, Edward Fitch, constantly complained that "the weapon I use now is not fit for combat" and repeatedly asked family and friends to send in Colt revolvers, preferably a pair.
The question is, the Sharps rifle is one of the strongest small weapons in the game, known for its high range, high accuracy, and fast rate of fire.     Why did Fitch say that the Sharps rifle was no good and that the revolver was better, or even the only choice of weapons he wanted?
To understand this, it is necessary to understand what Fitch meant by fighting.     In Kansas, for Free States, fighting usually did not mean opposing armies.     It meant being robbed or even killed by border bandits who burst out on the road while they were traveling, and the same thing happened when Free States were working in their fields or sleeping in their homes.
Sharps rifles can be incredibly effective in regular warfare, but they're not very useful to civilians against sudden border bandits, where you need to be able to fire a lot of bullets in a split second and you don't need to worry about the hit rate, because you need to pin the enemy down as quickly as possible, and that's what makes a revolver a self-defense weapon.
In terms of average rate of fire per minute, the Sharps rifle is actually similar to a revolver, because the Sharps rifle division loads and fires a single shot, while the revolver can fire six rounds in one go but takes longer to reload.     With this in mind, I programmed both series of weapons to attack twice per turn in the original.
Rethinking Fitch's complaint and request, I decided to adjust the weapon parameters, changing the revolver type weapon to three attacks per turn to highlight its suppressing effect, of course, if the actual test later found that the revolver became too powerful, I will reduce the hit rate of this type of weapon accordingly.
This successfully solved the problem of differences between the two weapons.
The revolver is also no longer a low-power version of the Sharps rifle, in the previous setting, in addition to the same two attacks, the hit rate and range are lower, the only significant difference is that the revolver is suitable for horseback combat, and after this update, the Spinner will have a stronger short and medium range suppression effect, and the character's own ability to improve the hit rate will be very helpful.

After writing the above, I conducted two hours of testing and found that the three-attack revolver was too strong, as I mentioned in the video, which is also the original intention of this weapon design, but the balance in the game was completely destroyed.
As I envisioned earlier, now we need to see if reducing hit ratio can balance out the impact of increasing attack return.
Continuing to test, I found that no matter how to reduce the hit rate is bad, hit rate does not seem to be a simple addition and subtraction problem.   So I gave up on the hit rate changes and came up with a new approach.
This time, the revolver does not increase the number of attacks, but increases the counterattack effect.   From a practical point of view, the revolver is indeed one of the few weapons that can respond quickly.   This new approach works very well, the battle is now much more exciting, you have to reconsider whether the enemy armed with a revolver will fight back, and because of this change, the purchase of weapons is finally no longer the pursuit of the long range and high accuracy of the shotgun category, the status of the revolver has increased significantly!
As mentioned earlier, normally I would choose a shotgun with a long range and high precision as my preferred weapon to purchase, but this time the revolver weapon has a counterattack effect, it is difficult to say which is more advantageous.
In addition, as counterattacks became more common, Anthony's previously unique counterattack ability was changed to critical strikes on counterattacks.
That's right, you never know how different an idea in development will be from an actual solution!

Further testing revealed that, surprisingly, the revolver's counter-attack effect highlighted the advantage of a long-range rifle, which could ensure that the revolver's counter-attack range was out of reach, something that had not been considered in the previous version.
The importance of recovery items has also increased accordingly, and there will no longer be a situation where you never buy recovery items.

Preview update: A comprehensive variety of ammunition, which will further increase supplies and combat strategy!

Torian

notes.title: What other heroes will follow?
notes.notes:
It was expected that there would be about 100 heroes to choose from, and now there are 22 names, which is already a big project, but there are sure to be more heroes as the story unfolds.

Since the initial plot needs to be spread out on a large scale, the appearance of heroes is relatively dense.    There is a long list of possible heroes, but since the plot mainly continues the story of the previous heroes, unless there is another main line, there will not be a large number of new heroes.

These early heroes are basically the most important heroes in this period of history, but the selection is not based on the person's birth, status, or power, for example, Robinson, one of the leaders of the Kansas chapter, is an NPC, because he is more concerned with his own interests than fighting for the right cause (as a doctor, He was also active on the battlefields of Kansas in the early stages, and can be of great help to the player when played correctly, although as an NPC).

After the Revolutionary War, the role of the first is, of course, Nicholas Augustine, and the companions who appear around the story of this young general.    The commander of our army, General Grant, will probably not appear as an optional hero, because such a role is headquarters.    Of course, a character like General Grant will still appear as an NPC unit on the battlefield if needed.

In general, the criteria for determining the candidate is more focused on the hero's bravery, integrity, selflessness, and kindness, which is the origin of the name of the game.

Torian

notes.title: v.0.4.11 新职业：记者、律师、机械师
notes.notes:
以往的游戏里，主角要么是将军，要么是总统，要么是上天入地穿梭时空无所不能的奇特生物，这次我们来点实在的。

职业跟活动类型对标，其实早先就想那么做了，只是当时有很多基本内容还没开发完，没有精力去做这一部分。

这次新增记者、律师、机械师三种职业，这将是有实际用处的，而不是像过去一样只是写在角色简介里的空头衔（其实早期概念里主角加里森就有作为报社主编的一整套玩法，如果有足够的赞助，这些都是可以重新启用和开发的）。

配套的还会新增一些职业工具，比如纸笔，扳手（医生已经有他的手术箱了）。


首先看角色简介就知道，塔潘和安东尼都是『纽约论坛报』的通信记者。虽然简介里没写，其实伍德也是记者，只不过这位多才多艺，打仗、参政、法律样样精通，所以记者这个身份容易被忘记。


四个初始主角，除了多伊外其他三个都是记者 。革命时代，真正令人尊敬的记者就是如此。当然，后续的主角就跟记者没大关系了，基本上都是农民、工人、匠人或商人，比克顿就是机械师。

医生可以行医，律师可以提供法律意见，这无疑是历史上第一个展现革命者的普通工作的游戏，不过做这些普通工作赚的钱会破坏游戏内的经济平衡，一如既往的还要相应的调整一下经济系统。

特利安

notes.title: Melee system, Big Map return, New Free Adventure mode preview
notes.notes:
A problem was found the day before yesterday, although the bayonet function was added, the bayonet can automatically switch to bayonet mode only when the bullets of the rifle equipped with the bayonet run out.       This is clearly unreasonable.       So I have been trying to solve this problem for two days, and now I have finally changed.       This is to save ammunition, or want to fight the enemy bayonet in the bunker (the bunker has a higher defense effect against guns) can be.       And ai outside the player can also use bayonets flexibly at any time.

As always, this raises two other questions.

First of all, whether the bayonet should be used as a single usable weapon, that is, not mounted on the gun, and the effect of installation is different.

Then, most basic melee fists (an early design, has been dropped in the current version), should be brought back.       Although it has now added the element of picking up stones or sticks anywhere for melee combat, after all, there is still a step of picking up, if people want to fight directly with their fists?       But can you ride with your fists?       What about the coachman?       It's all a problem.

In addition, large maps that could be moved freely still had to be made, including walking, horse-drawn carriages, ferries, trains, and various elements of towns, ferries, forts, and wilderness.

Only this time it is not the story mode that needs it (story mode is also known as history mode, just go with history, don't wander around), but the adventure mode (or call it freedom mode) that has been planned for a long time, and the earliest concept version can actually see these shadows.

Remember that poll I did a while back about the hair and eye color of female characters?       This is all for custom characters in Adventure mode.       Of course, since there is no custom function for vertical painting, it is only possible to draw a custom character image of public taste.       By the way, the vote was overwhelmingly for the blond, blue-eyed character.

There is no doubt that the roles played by men and women in that era were vastly different, and men naturally need not explain that almost all the protagonists in this work are men, and they have a wide range of careers.       And women, in the first place, can't be in the military, except as nurses.       In summary, in adventure mode, custom characters are male and enjoy a great deal of freedom at all levels, while women have a unique set of gameplay and story within many constraints.

Torian

notes.title: Military Rank
notes.notes:
New rank system, now the role of the rank has a substantial role!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43726027/b8b084925e873120c961167816404fdc386dfbfd.png[/img]

In the first edition I made the usual Infantry (blue), Cavalry (yellow), Artillery (red), and in the second edition I added Sharpshooters, Mounted Infantry (green), Dragoons (orange), and a full set of staff officer epaulets (black).

At present, it has included most of the ranks from corporal to general, and some uncommon ranks.    As medic, engineer, signal soldier, chaplain, etc.,  will be filled after the corresponding role.

As mentioned in the previous announcement, there will be British, French, Prussians, Russian, shogunate, and even Qing armies in the Campaign Mode that are not in the Story Mode, so what is their set of ranks and symbols, which is yet to be further studied by me.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43726027/b00e90e64ba8cc5d19b66e2f81a43938b3f8c182.png[/img]

For non-commissioned officers, lieutenants, and colonels, the rank can only be influence to their own troops, and starting with Brigadier General, additional bonuses will be awarded to our surrounding troops.

Although the general only has the size of the guard, but the bonus effect is still very powerful.       Having a general will effectively increase the combat power of our troops around, and the bonus can be stacked, so collecting more general units is not a bad thing.

Due to the low HP, it is of course very dangerous for the general to be Concentrated attack by the enemy, but due to the relatively large command area (Brigadier command area of 3, major-General command area of 5), you can choose to keep your general away from the crossfire area and command the battle in the rear.

If the General Guard is armed with Henry Rifles, and then upgraded to a higher level, with high fire output and high mobility, the General itself is a good fighting unit.

The next patch will probably release Grant and Sherman, and we will see the General and General of the Army have an incredible advantage in this regard.

Torian

notes.title: Announcements about price cuts and other issues
notes.notes:
[b] About the price [/b]

In the beginning, I set the price very high, mainly for two purposes, one is to deter those haters who threatened to brush up on bad reviews, and the other is to better raise crowdfunding. However, I later found out that platform sharing and taxation can greatly reduce the effectiveness of crowdfunding, and haters can still refund and write bad reviews. So I decided to adjust the price to an appropriate position. In any case, this work will eventually have to be made available to the public. As the game is updated, the price will gradually adjust back.

[b] About DLC[/b]

As the author has promised in the past, the game's body will contain everything, and there will never be DLC. The author himself hates the idea of making money with a lot of DLC.

[b] About English [/b]

Because I'm Chinese, my native language is Chinese, and of course this game was made in Chinese.   For the English version that many netizens are eagerly looking forward to, I don't have the money to hire a human translator, so I can only use translation software to translate the Chinese text into English for the time being.   For non-native Chinese speakers, it is at least better than not understanding the plot and dialogue at all.   I will do my best to proofread the English names and places as much as possible.   The game has a lot of text, so I will adjust my priorities and update the English version as much as possible.

After recent research, Stearns of Lawrence was initially not an abolitionist, as some sources claim, but more likely a pro-slavery Missourian, rewrite the story based on new research. Stearns built the first log cabin in Lawrence, later known as the abolitionist stronghold, and was the first pioneer to live there.  Several documents describe Stearns as an abolitionist in Pennsylvania, another as a supporter of slavery in Missouri, and one document says he was born in New York, although the year of his birth varies.
